_comment: Proposed default AOIs. Track B and C own the final list and the justification text. bbox = [west, south, east, north].

regions.name: Gran Chaco (AR / BO / PY)
regions.why: Local impact story: the 2020-2022 Chaco fire seasons and the CONAE photo credit in the challenge brief.

regions.name: Brazilian Amazon (deforestation arc)
regions.why: The best-known seasonal fire signal on Earth, with a long MODIS record and a well-documented 2019 anomaly.

regions.name: Cerrado
regions.why: Fire-adapted savanna with strong wet/dry seasonality and heavy agricultural burning.

regions.name: California
regions.why: High-profile wildfire regime with a shift from summer to year-round fire in the record.

regions.name: Iberian Peninsula
regions.why: Compact Mediterranean fire regime, dense observations, easy to explain to a European audience.

regions.name: South-East Australia
regions.why: The 2019-20 Black Summer is the cleanest cross-sensor validation event available.

regions.name: Eastern Siberia
regions.why: Boreal fire with a strong recent trend and a short ice-free season; tests the harmonization where MODIS struggles.

regions.name: Sahel
regions.why: Agricultural burning calendar dominated by small, short-lived fires that VIIRS sees and MODIS often misses.

regions.name: Borneo
regions.why: Peat fires and land-clearing, with a very different detection profile from crown fires.
